scientific_integrity: The previous piecewise constant invariant densities and Lyapunov plateau are credited as prior results; the additional claims are the sharp first-lag sign change and exact odd/even all-lag sensor correlation law.
scientific_limitations: The stationary law is the particular absolutely continuous invariant probability from the cited source, not an arbitrary invariant probability.
The exact parameter-dependent one-lag formula is confined to 3<=beta<9/2, and the all-lag parity law to beta=4.
An absence of matching results in inspected sources does not constitute a guarantee of historical priority; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Odd-lag independence and even-lag memory in a Lyapunov plateau
